message: サリーちゃんの暗躍

name: Synn
message: 「KiraFes is officially a go. Once again--」

name: Everyone
message: 「Congratulations!」

name: Synn
message: 「As you all know, I think the real hard part starts now. Things might get even busier than before.」

name: Misa
message: 「We can't let the students down, after all. We're going to make this event a success, no matter what!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So exciting! Things are really heating up!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm itching to get started!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ufufu, I can't wait to see how it turns out.」
Even though today is a day off, everyone gathers in the Student Council room, full of enthusiasm.

name: Helena
message: 「Now, now. Getting all hyped up over the new project is fine and all, but don't forget what's really important.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Making a normal entrance for once? That's rare for you, Madam Chairwoman.」

name: Helena
message: 「You all have a guest.」

name: Ria
message: 「A guest?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yaho--!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah!」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm Sally-chan, the idol of the Demon World! Nice to meetcha!」

name: Misa
message: 「Bringing a demon right into the Crusaders' headquarters...」

name: Helena
message: 「It's hardly something worth hiding. Not like it hurts anyone.」

name: Sally
message: 「Thanks, old la--」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa-oa-oa-oa. Oopsie.」

name: Sally
message: 「I mean, hey, BOSS!」

name: Helena
message: 「Mm-hm, good answer. This academy really needs an honest, cute girl like you.」

name: Sally
message: 「Ehehe. Stop it, BOSS~」
It's an exchange that makes you sure something must have happened on their way here.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Cute...?」

name: Sally
message: 「What's with that question mark!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Wh-wh-whoa there. Bad, bad. Calm down, cool and collected, cool and collected.」

name: Helena
message: 「Well then, I'm counting on you with the rest.」
Saying that, Helena-san gave a little wave and walked out.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I wonder what on earth we're even supposed to handle, and how.」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe she wanted to say, 'Don't forget about exterminating the Demons either'?」

name: Ria
message: 「Aah~~, maybe so.」

name: Sally
message: 「Bleh! My only BOSS is Oyabin, you know!」
Picking a fight with Helena-san takes quite some admirable guts.

name: Lolotte
message: 「The Chairwoman sure is a worrywart. No matter how you look at it, the Demon extermination is going smoothly, isn't it?」

name: Misa
message: 「Is that really true? Even right now, one is strutting right in front of us without a care in the world.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, but it's not like she's doing anything bad, either.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, I know! She's going to do something bad from now on, I bet.」

name: Ria
message: 「Sally-chan. What did you come here to do?」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm so glad you asked! Actually, you see--」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oooooh.」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh~」

name: Sally
message: 「I haven't even said anything yet!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Listen. I want you to let me join the 'Student Council'!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh!」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Join us? What's wrong, did you catch a cold or something?」

name: Misa
message: 「No matter how you look at her, she seems perfectly healthy.」

name: Ria
message: 「Really? Still, the seasons are changing, so you have to be careful.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It will be fine. After all, it is written that idiots never catch colds.」

name: Sally
message: 「I said, why are you changing the subject!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Listen, Sally-chan. To join the Student Council, you first have to win an election.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Before even that, one must actually be a student at the academy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now. Even if she can't become a Student Council officer, she can at least help out, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「Before even that, this girl is a demon and our enemy.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So you have finally had a change of heart. Truly, this is a miracle wrought by my love.」

name: Sally
message: 「Pffft. She totally fell for it.」

name: Sally
message: 「--And so, nice working with you starting today!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I don't really get the 'and so' part, but nice working with you.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Pleased to work with you, Ms. Extra.」

name: Synn
message: 「E-Extra?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Since she is essentially an extra tacked onto the Student Council, she is Ms. Extra.\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on, you guys. Do you even hear what you're saying?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yesterday's enemy is today's friend.」

name: Ria
message: 「'You and me, clink-clink, Daijirou~♪'」

name: Misa
message: 「She's definitely plotting something, I just know it.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, Misa-chan. Don't you think it's safer having her with us than letting her run around free?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Well, that's true.」

name: Ria
message: 「Then it's settled.\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Uhh. Anyone who objects to letting Sally-chan join our group--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, no objections here.」

name: Misa
message: 「I only went along with Senpai's wonderful idea, I'm not agreeing with you, Sakura-kun.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're so nitpicky.」
After that, following some brief self-introductions, Student Council activities began with Sally-chan included.
